questions.q: Which of these is part of the cell theory?
questions.qAf: Watter een hiervan is deel van die selteorie?
options: All cells come from pre-existing cells
Only animals are made of cells
Cells can form from non-living matter
Every cell has a cell wall
optionsAf: Alle selle kom van bestaande selle
Selle kan uit nie-lewende materie vorm
questions.explain: The cell theory: all living things are made of cells, the cell is the basic unit of life, and all cells come from pre-existing cells.
questions.explainAf: Die selteorie: alle lewende dinge bestaan uit selle, die sel is die basiese eenheid van lewe, en alle selle kom van bestaande selle.

questions.q: Why are cells so small?
questions.qAf: Waarom is selle so klein?
options: A small cell has a large surface area compared with its volume, so it exchanges materials efficiently
Big cells would be too heavy to move
Cells have no membrane, so they must be small
optionsAf: 'n Klein sel het 'n groot oppervlakte in verhouding tot sy volume, dus ruil dit stowwe doeltreffend uit
Klein selle het geen suurstof nodig nie
Groot selle sou te swaar wees om te beweeg
Selle het geen membraan nie, dus moet hulle klein wees
questions.explain: A large surface area to volume ratio lets oxygen, nutrients and waste cross the membrane fast enough. In a very large cell the centre would not get enough oxygen.
questions.explainAf: 'n Groot verhouding van oppervlakte tot volume laat suurstof, voedingstowwe en afval vinnig genoeg deur die membraan beweeg. In 'n baie groot sel sou die middel nie genoeg suurstof kry nie.

questions.q: A sailor on a long voyage eats no fresh fruit or vegetables and develops scurvy. Which vitamin is missing?
questions.qAf: 'n Matroos op 'n lang seereis eet geen vars vrugte of groente nie en kry skeurbuik. Watter vitamien kort?
questions.explain: Scurvy comes from too little vitamin C, found in citrus fruit and peppers. A lack of vitamin A causes night blindness, and of vitamin D, rickets.
questions.explainAf: Skeurbuik kom van te min vitamien C, wat in sitrusvrugte en soetrissies voorkom. 'n Tekort aan vitamien A veroorsaak nagblindheid, en aan vitamien D, ragitis.

questions.q: Which parent's gamete decides whether a baby is a boy or a girl?
questions.qAf: Watter ouer se gameet bepaal of 'n baba 'n seun of 'n dogter is?
options: The father's sperm, which carries either an X or a Y chromosome
The mother's egg, which carries either an X or a Y chromosome
Neither; it depends on the temperature
optionsAf: Die vader se sperm, wat óf 'n X- óf 'n Y-chromosoom dra
Die moeder se eiersel, wat óf 'n X- óf 'n Y-chromosoom dra
Geeneen nie; dit hang van die temperatuur af
questions.explain: All eggs carry an X. A Y-carrying sperm gives a boy (XY); an X-carrying sperm gives a girl (XX).
questions.explainAf: Alle eierselle dra 'n X. 'n Sperm met 'n Y gee 'n seun (XY); 'n sperm met 'n X gee 'n dogter (XX).

questions.q: Magnesium has the electron arrangement 2,8,2. How many valence electrons does it have?
questions.qAf: Magnesium het die elektronrangskikking 2,8,2. Hoeveel valenselektrone het dit?
questions.explain: Valence electrons are those in the outermost shell: the last number, 2. Magnesium is in Group 2.
questions.explainAf: Valenselektrone is dié in die buitenste dop: die laaste getal, 2. Magnesium is in Groep 2.

questions.q: Why are the noble gases almost completely unreactive?
questions.qAf: Waarom is die edelgasse amper heeltemal onreaktief?
options: Their outer shells are completely full
optionsAf: Hul buitenste doppe is heeltemal vol
questions.explain: With a full outer shell they have no drive to gain, lose or share electrons, so they exist as single atoms.
questions.explainAf: Met 'n vol buitenste dop het hulle geen drang om elektrone te kry, te verloor of te deel nie, dus bestaan hulle as enkel atome.

questions.q: When sodium forms an ionic bond with chlorine, what happens to the sodium atom?
questions.qAf: Wanneer natrium 'n ioniese binding met chloor vorm, wat gebeur met die natriumatoom?
options: It loses one electron and becomes a positive ion, Na⁺
It gains one electron and becomes a negative ion, Na⁻
It shares a pair of electrons with chlorine
optionsAf: Dit verloor een elektron en word 'n positiewe ioon, Na⁺
Dit kry een elektron en word 'n negatiewe ioon, Na⁻
questions.explain: The metal loses its valence electron to become a cation (Na⁺); chlorine gains it to become an anion (Cl⁻). The opposite charges attract.
questions.explainAf: Die metaal verloor sy valenselektron en word 'n katioon (Na⁺); chloor kry dit en word 'n anioon (Cl⁻). Die teenoorgestelde ladings trek mekaar aan.

questions.q: How many pairs of electrons are shared in the bond between the two atoms of a nitrogen molecule, N₂?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel elektronpare word gedeel in die binding tussen die twee atome van 'n stikstofmolekuul, N₂?
questions.explain: N≡N is a triple bond: three shared pairs. O=O is a double bond and H–H a single bond.
questions.explainAf: N≡N is 'n drievoudige binding: drie gedeelde pare. O=O is 'n dubbelbinding en H–H 'n enkelbinding.

questions.q: Why would a learner use universal indicator instead of litmus?
questions.qAf: Waarom sou 'n leerder universele indikator in plaas van lakmoes gebruik?
options: It gives a range of colours, so you can estimate the pH value
optionsAf: Dit gee 'n reeks kleure, dus kan jy die pH-waarde skat
questions.explain: Universal indicator is a mixture of indicators with colours across the whole pH scale. Litmus only shows acid (red) or base (blue).
questions.explainAf: Universele indikator is 'n mengsel van indikators met kleure oor die hele pH-skaal. Lakmoes wys net suur (rooi) of basis (blou).

questions.q: Hydrochloric acid (HCl) neutralises potassium hydroxide (KOH). Which salt forms?
questions.qAf: Soutsuur (HCl) neutraliseer kaliumhidroksied (KOH). Watter sout vorm?
questions.explain: HCl + KOH → KCl + H₂O. The salt takes the metal from the base (potassium) and the anion from the acid (chloride).
questions.explainAf: HCl + KOH → KCl + H₂O. Die sout kry die metaal van die basis (kalium) en die anioon van die suur (chloried).

questions.q: Iron displaces copper from copper sulfate solution, but copper cannot displace iron from iron sulfate. Why?
questions.qAf: Yster verplaas koper uit kopersulfaatoplossing, maar koper kan nie yster uit ystersulfaat verplaas nie. Waarom?
options: Iron is above copper in the activity series (it is more reactive)
Copper is more reactive than iron
Iron sulfate is not a compound
optionsAf: Yster is bo koper in die reaktiwiteitsreeks (dit is meer reaktief)
Koper is meer reaktief as yster
questions.explain: A metal can only displace metals below it in the activity series. Fe is above Cu, so Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu works, but not the reverse.
questions.explainAf: 'n Metaal kan net metale onder hom in die reaktiwiteitsreeks verplaas. Fe is bo Cu, dus werk Fe + CuSO₄ → FeSO₄ + Cu, maar nie andersom nie.

questions.q: A cork floating on a pond bobs up and down as a wave passes, but it does not travel with the wave. What does this show?
questions.qAf: 'n Kurk wat op 'n dam dryf, wip op en af soos 'n golf verbygaan, maar dit beweeg nie saam met die golf nie. Wat wys dit?
options: The cork is too heavy to move
optionsAf: Golwe dra energie oor, nie materie nie
Golwe dra materie oor, nie energie nie
Die kurk is te swaar om te beweeg
questions.explain: The particles vibrate and return to their rest position; only the energy moves along.
questions.explainAf: Die deeltjies vibreer en keer terug na hul rusposisie; net die energie beweeg voort.

questions.q: What is the wavelength of a wave?
questions.qAf: Wat is die golflengte van 'n golf?
options: The distance from one crest to the next crest
The height of a crest above the rest position
The number of waves per second
The time for one complete wave
optionsAf: Die afstand van een kruin tot die volgende kruin
Die hoogte van 'n kruin bo die rusposisie
Die tyd vir een volledige golf
questions.explain: Wavelength (λ) is the distance between two identical consecutive points, such as crest to crest. The height is the amplitude; waves per second is the frequency; the time for one wave is the period.
questions.explainAf: Golflengte (λ) is die afstand tussen twee identiese opeenvolgende punte, soos kruin tot kruin. Die hoogte is die amplitude; golwe per sekonde is die frekwensie; die tyd vir een golf is die periode.

questions.q: How fast do all electromagnetic waves travel in a vacuum?
questions.qAf: Hoe vinnig beweeg alle elektromagnetiese golwe in 'n vakuum?
options: They cannot travel in a vacuum
optionsAf: Dit hang van hul kleur af
Hulle kan nie in 'n vakuum beweeg nie
questions.explain: All EM waves travel at the speed of light, c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, in a vacuum. They differ only in frequency and wavelength. 340 m/s is sound in air.
questions.explainAf: Alle EM-golwe beweeg teen die spoed van lig, c = 3 × 10⁸ m/s, in 'n vakuum. Hulle verskil net in frekwensie en golflengte. 340 m/s is klank in lug.

questions.q: Which electromagnetic waves are the most dangerous to living tissue?
questions.qAf: Watter elektromagnetiese golwe is die gevaarlikste vir lewende weefsel?
questions.explain: Gamma rays have the highest frequency and the most energy. They are ionising: they can knock electrons from atoms and damage DNA.
questions.explainAf: Gammastrale het die hoogste frekwensie en die meeste energie. Hulle is ioniserend: hulle kan elektrone van atome afslaan en DNS beskadig.

questions.q: What is the difference between weight and mass?
questions.qAf: Wat is die verskil tussen gewig en massa?
options: Weight is the force of gravity on a mass, measured in newtons; mass is measured in kilograms
Mass is a force measured in newtons
optionsAf: Gewig is die swaartekrag op 'n massa, gemeet in newton; massa word in kilogram gemeet
Massa is 'n krag wat in newton gemeet word
questions.explain: Weight = mass × gravitational field strength (W = m × g). It is a force, so it is measured in newtons (N).
questions.explainAf: Gewig = massa × gravitasieveldsterkte (W = m × g). Dit is 'n krag, dus word dit in newton (N) gemeet.

questions.q: A learner replaces a short piece of nichrome wire in a circuit with a longer piece of the same thickness. What happens?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder vervang 'n kort stuk nichroomdraad in 'n stroombaan met 'n langer stuk van dieselfde dikte. Wat gebeur?
options: The resistance increases, so the current decreases
The resistance decreases, so the current increases
The voltage of the cell doubles
optionsAf: Die weerstand neem toe, dus neem die stroom af
Die weerstand neem af, dus neem die stroom toe
Die spanning van die sel verdubbel
questions.explain: A longer conductor has more resistance, because the electrons collide with more particles along the way. A thicker one has less.
questions.explainAf: 'n Langer geleier het meer weerstand, omdat die elektrone met meer deeltjies langs die pad bots. 'n Dikker een het minder.

questions.q: Two 1.5 V cells are connected in series. What is the total voltage?
questions.qAf: Twee 1,5 V-selle word in serie gekoppel. Wat is die totale spanning?
questions.explain: Cells in series add their voltages: 1.5 + 1.5 = 3 V.
questions.explainAf: Selle in serie se spannings word bymekaargetel: 1,5 + 1,5 = 3 V.

questions.q: What does the earth wire in a plug do?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die aarddraad in 'n prop?
options: It gives current a safe path into the ground if there is a fault
It makes the appliance use less electricity
optionsAf: Dit gee stroom 'n veilige pad na die grond as daar 'n fout is
Dit laat die toestel minder elektrisiteit gebruik
questions.explain: Earthing sends the current into the ground, rather than through a person who touches a faulty appliance.
questions.explainAf: Aarding stuur die stroom na die grond, eerder as deur 'n persoon wat aan 'n foutiewe toestel raak.

questions.q: Which gas makes up about 78% of the atmosphere?
questions.qAf: Watter gas maak ongeveer 78% van die atmosfeer uit?
questions.explain: Nitrogen 78%, oxygen 21%, and the remaining 1% is argon, carbon dioxide and other gases.
questions.explainAf: Stikstof 78%, suurstof 21%, en die oorblywende 1% is argon, koolstofdioksied en ander gasse.

questions.q: In which layer of the atmosphere does all our weather happen?
questions.qAf: In watter laag van die atmosfeer vind al ons weer plaas?
questions.explain: The troposphere (0–12 km) holds about 75% of the atmosphere's mass, and all weather happens there.
questions.explainAf: Die troposfeer (0–12 km) bevat ongeveer 75% van die atmosfeer se massa, en alle weer vind daar plaas.

questions.q: What did the Montreal Protocol of 1987 do?
questions.qAf: Wat het die Montreal-protokol van 1987 gedoen?
options: It banned CFCs, which were destroying the ozone layer
It banned the burning of coal
It set up the first weather station
It named the layers of the atmosphere
optionsAf: Dit het CFK's verbied, wat die osoonlaag vernietig het
Dit het die verbranding van steenkool verbied
Dit het die eerste weerstasie opgerig
Dit het die lae van die atmosfeer benoem
questions.explain: CFCs from old fridges and aerosol sprays destroyed ozone and caused a hole over Antarctica. Since the ban, the ozone layer is slowly recovering.
questions.explainAf: CFK's uit ou yskaste en spuitkannetjies het osoon vernietig en 'n gat oor Antarktika veroorsaak. Sedert die verbod herstel die osoonlaag stadig.

questions.q: In which type of rock are most fossils found?
questions.qAf: In watter soort gesteente word die meeste fossiele gevind?
questions.explain: Sedimentary rock forms from layers of sediment that can bury organisms. The heat and pressure that form igneous and metamorphic rock destroy fossils.
questions.explainAf: Sedimentêre gesteente vorm uit lae sediment wat organismes kan begrawe. Die hitte en druk wat stollings- en metamorfe gesteente vorm, vernietig fossiele.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: In asexual reproduction, the offspring are genetically identical to the parent.
questions.qAf: By ongeslagtelike voortplanting is die nakomelinge geneties identies aan die ouer.
questions.explain: True. The offspring are clones. That is fast, but there is no genetic variation, so the whole population can be wiped out by one disease.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Die nakomelinge is klone. Dit is vinnig, maar daar is geen genetiese variasie nie, dus kan een siekte die hele bevolking uitwis.

questions.q: Solid sodium chloride conducts electricity.
questions.qAf: Vaste natriumchloried gelei elektrisiteit.
questions.explain: False. In the solid the ions are locked in the lattice. Ionic compounds conduct only when melted or dissolved, when the ions are free to move.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. In die vaste stof is die ione in die rooster vasgevang. Ioniese verbindings gelei net wanneer dit gesmelt of opgelos is, wanneer die ione vry kan beweeg.

questions.q: Friction always acts in the opposite direction to the motion.
questions.qAf: Wrywing werk altyd in die teenoorgestelde rigting van die beweging.
questions.explain: True. Friction opposes motion (or attempted motion) between surfaces in contact.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Wrywing werk beweging (of beoogde beweging) tussen oppervlakke wat aan mekaar raak, teë.

questions.q: A circuit breaker can be reset and used again after it trips, unlike a fuse.
questions.qAf: 'n Stroombreker kan teruggestel en weer gebruik word nadat dit uitgeskakel het, anders as 'n sekering.
questions.explain: True. A fuse wire melts and must be replaced; a circuit breaker is a switch that opens automatically and can be reset.
questions.explainAf: Waar. 'n Sekeringdraad smelt en moet vervang word; 'n stroombreker is 'n skakelaar wat outomaties oopgaan en teruggestel kan word.

questions.q: Without any greenhouse effect, Earth's average surface temperature would be about −18 °C.
questions.qAf: Sonder enige kweekhuiseffek sou die Aarde se gemiddelde oppervlaktemperatuur ongeveer −18 °C wees.
questions.explain: True. The natural greenhouse effect keeps the average at about +15 °C, roughly 33 °C warmer.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Die natuurlike kweekhuiseffek hou die gemiddelde op ongeveer +15 °C, sowat 33 °C warmer.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each food test in column A with the result that shows a positive test in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke voedseltoets in kolom A by die resultaat wat 'n positiewe toets wys in kolom B.
questions.explain: Benedict's turns orange/red with reducing sugars, Biuret turns purple with protein, and fat leaves a translucent spot on brown paper. Lime water turning milky is the test for carbon dioxide.
questions.explainAf: Benedict s'n verkleur oranje/rooi met reduserende suikers, Biuret verkleur pers met proteïen, en vet laat 'n deurskynende kol op bruin papier. Kalkwater wat melkerig word, is die toets vir koolstofdioksied.

questions.q: Match each type of electromagnetic wave in column A with a use in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke soort elektromagnetiese golf in kolom A by 'n gebruik in kolom B.
extra: Finding the depth of the sea with SONAR
extraAf: Om die diepte van die see met SONAR te vind
questions.explain: Microwaves cook and are used in radar, infrared is used in remotes and thermal cameras, and X-rays make medical images. SONAR uses sound, which is not an EM wave.
questions.explainAf: Mikrogolwe kook en word in radar gebruik, infrarooi word in afstandbeheer en termiese kameras gebruik, en X-strale maak mediese beelde. SONAR gebruik klank, wat nie 'n EM-golf is nie.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each type of fossil to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke soort fossiel aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
pairs: An insect trapped in hardened tree resin
questions.explain: A body fossil is part of the organism itself, a trace fossil is evidence of its activity, and amber preserves organisms trapped in resin.
questions.explainAf: 'n Liggaamsfossiel is deel van die organisme self, 'n spoorfossiel is bewys van sy aktiwiteit, en amber bewaar organismes wat in hars vasgevang is.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put these substances in order from the most acidic to the most alkaline.
questions.qAf: Plaas hierdie stowwe in volgorde van die mees suur tot die mees alkalies.
questions.explain: A lower pH is more acidic and a higher pH more alkaline; 7 is neutral.
questions.explainAf: 'n Laer pH is meer suur en 'n hoër pH meer alkalies; 7 is neutraal.

questions.q: Put the layers of the atmosphere in order, from the ground upwards.
questions.qAf: Plaas die lae van die atmosfeer in volgorde, van die grond af boontoe.
questions.explain: Troposphere (0–12 km), stratosphere (12–50 km), mesosphere (50–80 km), thermosphere (80–700 km). The temperature goes down, up, down, up.
questions.explainAf: Troposfeer (0–12 km), stratosfeer (12–50 km), mesosfeer (50–80 km), termosfeer (80–700 km). Die temperatuur gaan af, op, af, op.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Free earlobes (F) are dominant over attached earlobes (f). A father with genotype Ff has a child with a mother whose genotype is ff.
questions.scenarioAf: Los oorlelle (F) is dominant oor vasgegroeide oorlelle (f). 'n Vader met genotipe Ff het 'n kind saam met 'n moeder wie se genotipe ff is.

questions.q: What kind of earlobes does the father have?
questions.qAf: Watter soort oorlelle het die vader?
questions.explain: Ff contains the dominant allele F, which masks f, so his earlobes are free.
questions.explainAf: Ff bevat die dominante alleel F, wat f maskeer, dus is sy oorlelle los.

questions.q: What is the chance that their child has attached earlobes?
questions.qAf: Wat is die kans dat hul kind vasgegroeide oorlelle het?
questions.explain: Ff × ff gives 1 Ff : 1 ff, so half the offspring are expected to be ff (attached).
questions.explainAf: Ff × ff gee 1 Ff : 1 ff, dus word verwag dat die helfte van die nakomelinge ff (vasgegroei) is.

questions.q: What word describes the mother's genotype, ff?
questions.qAf: Watter woord beskryf die moeder se genotipe, ff?
questions.explain: Two copies of the recessive allele: homozygous recessive. Ff, with one of each, is heterozygous.
questions.explainAf: Twee kopieë van die resessiewe alleel: homosigoties resessief. Ff, met een van elk, is heterosigoties.

questions.q: You can always tell a person's genotype by looking at their earlobes.
questions.qAf: Jy kan altyd 'n persoon se genotipe bepaal deur na hul oorlelle te kyk.
questions.explain: False. Free earlobes can be FF or Ff. You see the phenotype, not the genotype.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Los oorlelle kan FF of Ff wees. Jy sien die fenotipe, nie die genotipe nie.
